text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Multiple services reporting Okta JWT validation failures (signature mismatch) affecting Console logins and API token verification. Trigger: 5xx responses from Okta JWKS endpoint in last 3m. Paging rota: joe_sre oncall. Please ack and triage.

maya: Acked. I'm on it. Seeing a spike in Console 401s for customer sessions, and backend auth checks returning 'signature_verification_failed'.

joe_sre: Looking. Can someone paste the auth logs? I want to see the raw downstream errors.

lina: Pasting recent logs from the auth-proxy:

```
ERROR auth.verify: user=svc-123: token=eyJhbGciOiJS...: signature_verification_failed (kid: abc123)
WARN auth.jwks: fetch_jwks failed: 502 Bad Gateway from https://dev-accounts.okta.com/oauth2/v1/keys
```

raj: We're also seeing increased 502/504 from Okta's jwks endpoint in A->B region. Status page shows partial degradation for ojkt region (link: https://status.okta.com/incidents/abc).

oliver_support: Customer reports: "We can't login to the Redwood Console (SSO) since ~09:12 UTC" — several mid-market customers blocked, some support tickets piling.

maya: Initial hypothesis: Okta is rotating keys or their jwks endpoint is flapping so our JWKS cache failed to refresh, causing signature mismatches when their signing key changed. Two mitigation paths: 1) Force immediate JWKS reload + temporarily accept tokens signed by cached alternate kids for short window, or 2) Enable a short-term bypass for Console login (support-only emergency login via one-time SSO bypass token).

joe_sre: I'm going to force a JWKS refresh on all auth-proxy nodes now. Command:

```
# force jwks refresh
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/svc/auth-proxy/admin/refresh-jwks" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

joe_sre: Done on 6/6 nodes. Monitoring for new 401s -> 200s.

lina: After refresh we're seeing some recovery for new logins but backlog of existing sessions still failing (they have old tokens referencing rotated kid). Suggestation: fallback verification logic to try verifying against previous key set for 5 minutes.

maya: Can we safely implement fallback? Any risk of accepting revoked tokens?

joe_sre: Risk minimal for 5m window; Okta rotation should be atomic but propagation delays happen. I'll push a small change to auth-proxy to accept previous jwks from cache for 300s as emergency patch. Commits and rollout being done.

```
# emergency patch (pseudo)
VERIFY_ORDER = [current_jwks, cached_previous_jwks]
CACHE_TTL_EMERGENCY = 300
```

joe_sre: Patch deployed to 50% canary -> 100% within 8m. Monitoring.

oliver_support: Drafting customer message for affected accounts: "We are aware of Okta key rotation causing temporary login errors. Engineers are applying a mitigation; please retry in a few minutes. We'll update in 30 minutes." Share PR for status page?

maya: Please push to status.redwood and add note about affected features (Console login, API token validation for webhook consumers). Severity: P2 -> P1 if >10% customers affected or critical enterprise tenant.

raj: Okta status now shows "Service Disruption" for JWKS, they are investigating. Link posted in the incident channel.

lina: Observability note: our auth error rate peaked at 09:14 UTC -> 650 requests/min of signature_verification_failed, now dropping after JWKS refresh.

joe_sre: Handoff: I'm going offline in ~20m for another incident. handing to maya for follow-up and customer comms. @maya please take lead. I've created PD incident: INC-2729 and attached runbook snippet.

maya: Taking lead. I'll coordinate with support and update status every 15m. Initial impact estimate: ~7% of active Console sessions in EU region failed to reauthenticate; some API consumers had transient 401s causing retries.

oliver_support: Noted. I'll prioritize tickets for enterprise customers and send targeted notices to top 20 affected orgs.

maya: Post-mitigation actions:
- Confirm with Okta when rotation completes and their upstream restores stable JWKS endpoint
- Add automatic retry/backoff when JWKS fetch returns 5xx and keep previous keys for 5m
- Add runbook step to force-refresh JWKS and emergency patch procedure
- Add monitoring alert to detect JWKS 5xx and signature failure spike earlier

joe_sre: Added runbook PR: github.com/redwood/runbooks/pulls/456

lina: Closing notes: No data exfiltration suspected. Tokens that failed were rejected; we did not accept unverified tokens. Emergency fallback limited to previously cached keys for 5 minutes only.

maya: Thanks team. Next update in 15m or sooner if Okta posts resolution.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2729 updated: severity -> P2, assigned -> maya, status -> mitigation in progress. Followup tasks added: customer-notify, runbook-update, postmortem.

joe_sre: :thumbsup: Thanks, handing off. Good job on quick mitigation.

oliver_support: Sending targeted emails now.

maya: Update 09:45 UTC - Okta reports issue mitigated on their end; our downstream metrics show errors back to baseline. Monitoring for 30m, then we'll start RCA.

lina: Agreed. I'll capture traces and token failure counts for the RCA. Exporting logs now.

maya: Closing timeline later with full RCA and action items. Thanks everyone. :pray:
